role: PlanetryItems-Velocity: central authoring and authenticated distribution of item definitions and language to PlanetryItems Paper backends.
platform: Velocity proxy configuration tool; actual ItemStacks, gameplay rules and optional RPG integrations remain on Paper/Purpur backends.
compatibility: Java17 bytecode and Velocity3.1.1 API; packaged runtime CI matrix Velocity3.1.1/Java17,3.4.0/Java21,4.2.0/Java25. Paired PlanetryItems with definitions-source proxy and sync protocol2 on Paper/Purpur26.1.2/Java25. One proxy authority; no database, HTTP listener, Spigot or Folia support.
integration: Owns recursive items/ YAML and lang.yml; items directory takes precedence over legacy items.yml. /planetryitemsvelocity or /piv reload/list/status requires explicit Velocity planetryitemsvelocity.admin or console. Shared private key authenticates nonce-bound HMAC-SHA256 plugin messages on planetry:items_sync. Backends poll every5s when a player carrier exists; empty/offline servers catch up after firstconnection. Complete snapshot<=2000000bytes,24Kchunks; backend authoritative registry/language validation, durable atomic paired cache then activation and ACK. Failed updates retain lastgood; no-cache backends defer item mutations without localfallback. Unknown transferred IDs in proxy mode preserved unusable until known, native bonuses suspended. Local config/integrations remain backend; no production installation automated. PlanetryVelocity issue19 grants continue using target backend catalog/API. Durable proxy generations and per-item proxy_generation LONG prevent stale known-ID migrations from reducing newer durability or metadata; full-storage unknown/future equipment stays suspended in place. Back up generation.dat and generation.initialized; backends reject rollback and same-generation forks.
validation: Java25 mvn -B -ntp clean verify compiles17bytecode. python3 scripts/smoke.py JAVA_EXECUTABLE target/planetry-items-velocity-VERSION.jar VELOCITY_VERSION on supported matrix. Unit tests exercise YAML/schema/bounds/permissions/source checks/reload retention and authenticated multipart ACK state. Matching Items suite plus scripts/sync-smoke.py validates realPaper with controlled player/transport fixtures, cachedrestart and unknownIDpreservation. Stage connected clients, actual optional plugins/resourcepacks, Purpur and cross-backend transfers; fixtures are not realclient acceptance. See docs/ACCEPTANCE.md. Generation regressions cover durable ordering/restart/failure, rollback/fork rejection and known-ID future item durability/full-storage equipped transfer preservation.
